Pakistan Army Chief Appears to Gain Control Over Nuclear Command

Reports indicate a significant shift in power in Pakistan, with Army Chief General Asim Munir reportedly gaining control over the country's nuclear command. This development suggests Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif may have lost substantial authority, potentially reducing his role to that of a figurehead. The coverage highlights the army's increasing dominance in political affairs.
